title: Connect Wolfia to Claude and ChatGPT
summary: Connect Wolfia to Claude or ChatGPT and answer security questionnaires and customer security questions from your approved knowledge base, with citations and your own Wolfia role.
body_markdown:
Connect Wolfia to Claude or ChatGPT and answer security questionnaires and customer security questions from your approved knowledge base, with citations and your own Wolfia role.


Today we’re launching the Wolfia connector for Claude and ChatGPT. Connect Wolfia to Claude or ChatGPT and your AI assistant answers security questionnaires, DDQs and customer security questions from your approved Wolfia knowledge base, with a citation for every answer, acting with your own Wolfia role.


## Why connect Wolfia to Claude and ChatGPT


Claude and ChatGPT write a good first draft, but on their own they treat a draft the same as your approved policy. Connected to Wolfia, they answer from the approved sources Wolfia keeps in sync, cite where each answer came from, and save edits back to Wolfia where your team reviews them.[Wolfia vs Claude](https://wolfia.com/blog/wolfia-vs-claude) covers the difference in more depth.


With the connector you can ask a security question and get a cited answer, find a document and get a download link, look up what you told a customer in past questionnaires, check which questionnaire answers still need attention, and edit and approve answers, all without leaving your assistant.


## What you need


- A Wolfia account in your organization. If you don’t have one, ask a Wolfia Admin to invite you.
- A Claude or ChatGPT account.
- The Wolfia MCP server URL, with no trailing slash.


```text
https://api.wolfia.com/mcp


```


## How to connect Wolfia to Claude


If Wolfia is listed in the Connectors Directory under **Customize > Connectors** , connect it from there and go toSign in to Wolfia . Otherwise, add it by URL.


**On a Free, Pro, Max or Ultra plan**


1. Go to **Customize > Connectors** .
2. Click **Add** , then **Add custom connector** .
3. Enter` Wolfia` as the name, enter the Wolfia server URL as the **MCP server URL** , and click **Continue** .
4. Keep the options Claude detects, **Sign in now** for authentication and **Register automatically** for the OAuth client.
5. Click **Add** , then **Connect** .


**On a Team or Enterprise plan,** an Owner adds Wolfia once for the organization.


1. Go to **Organization settings > Connectors** .
2. Select **Add** , then **Custom** . If Claude asks for the connector type, choose **Web** .
3. Enter the Wolfia server URL, using the same sign-in settings as above.
4. Click **Add** .


Each member then goes to **Customize > Connectors** , finds Wolfia and clicks **Connect** to sign in with their own Wolfia account.


To use Wolfia in a chat, click **+** , select **Connectors** and turn Wolfia on.


## How to connect Wolfia to ChatGPT


1. Go to[ChatGPT Plugins](https://chatgpt.com/plugins) .
2. Select **Add** , then **Add custom MCP server** .
3. Enter` Wolfia` as the name, and a short description.
4. Under **Connection** , keep **Server URL** selected and enter the Wolfia server URL.
5. Keep **Authentication** set to **OAuth** , so each person signs in with their own Wolfia account.
6. Review the risk warning and select **I understand and want to continue** .
7. Select **Create as a plugin** , and review the tools ChatGPT found.


To use Wolfia, install the plugin and start a new conversation. Type **@** in the prompt box and select Wolfia.


ChatGPT connections get Wolfia’s dedicated tools. The general-purpose tools that reach the rest of the Wolfia web app are available in other clients.


## Sign in to Wolfia


1. When you connect, a browser window opens. Use your usual Wolfia sign-in, SSO or email.
2. Wolfia shows a consent screen naming where your sign-in will go, such as` claude.ai` . It warns you when the application registered recently or when nobody in your organization has approved that destination before.
3. Check the destination, and click **Approve** only if you started the connection yourself.
4. Go back to Claude or ChatGPT. You’re connected.


Your client refreshes access on its own, and asks you to sign in again after 90 days without use.


## What the Wolfia connector can do with your role


Every tool runs as you, with your Wolfia role, inside your organization. Your AI client only sees and changes what you can see and change in Wolfia.


Role What the connection can do


User Chat, search, documents, Slack, questionnaires, customer records and contract obligations, and read knowledge gaps, pre-approved answers and AI instructions


Expert Everything a User can do, and edit shared content such as knowledge, corrections, pre-approved answers and instructions, and work the trust center access request queue


Admin Everything an Expert can do, and read analytics, manage trust center settings, and approve waiting changes in Wolfia


Wolfia has two OAuth permissions.` chat:read` covers tools that read, and` chat:write` covers tools that make changes. A client that asks for` chat:read` alone only gets tools that read.


Changes that are hard to undo wait for a person. Deleting something through the Wolfia delete tool, approving a whole email domain or publishing a trust center update creates a request that an Admin approves in Wolfia, and nothing changes until they do. Your AI client can’t approve anything.


## Examples to try in Claude and ChatGPT


Ask What Wolfia does Role


Ask Wolfia whether we encrypt customer data at rest, and show the citations. Answers from your approved knowledge, with citations User


Find our latest penetration test summary in Wolfia and give me a download link. Searches your knowledge base and returns a download link User


What have we told Contoso about data residency in past questionnaires? Searches only that customer’s questionnaires User


What’s the status of my latest questionnaires, and how many answers still need attention? Lists your questionnaires and their answer counts User


Change the answer to question 12 on the Contoso questionnaire to say we rotate keys annually, and approve it. Edits and approves the answer, following that questionnaire’s permissions User


How much time did Wolfia and our reviewers spend on our recent questionnaires? Reports time spent by Wolfia and by people Admin


[Ask Wolfia](https://wolfia.com/blog/ask-wolfia-launch) explains how answers and citations work. Signed-in customers can read every tool and the role it needs in the[tools reference](https://wolfia.com/docs/how-to/mcp-tools) .


## How Wolfia handles your data in Claude and ChatGPT


- Wolfia receives what your AI client sends to a tool, such as the question you asked, and returns the result to that client. Your Claude or ChatGPT conversation is then handled under that provider’s terms.
- Wolfia will not use customer service data, meaning indexed content or queries, to train general-purpose AI models offered externally by Wolfia or third parties without explicit prior written consent.
- Retention of service data is governed by your agreement with Wolfia and your configuration. When you terminate your account, service data is retained for 30 days for data retrieval, then deleted from active systems.


The[Wolfia privacy policy](https://wolfia.com/privacy) has the categories of data, purposes, recipients and retention periods. The[terms](https://wolfia.com/terms) cover use of the service.


## How to disconnect Wolfia


**In Claude,** go to **Customize > Connectors** and click **Remove** . Team and Enterprise Owners use **Organization settings > Connectors** . To keep the connection but limit it, turn Wolfia off for a chat from **+ > Connectors** , or set a single tool to **Blocked** on the connector’s page.


**In ChatGPT,** go to[ChatGPT Plugins](https://chatgpt.com/plugins) , open **More actions** on the Wolfia plugin and select **Uninstall** .


A Wolfia Admin who deactivates an account also ends that account’s connections.


## Troubleshooting


Problem Fix


The Wolfia tools don’t appear In Claude, check that Wolfia shows **Connected** under **Your connectors** , then turn it on from **+ > Connectors** . In ChatGPT, start a new conversation and select Wolfia with **@** .


Sign-in fails or loops Sign in with the account in your Wolfia organization. Remove the connection and add it again.


A tool you expected is missing Your Wolfia role doesn’t include it. Ask a Wolfia Admin to check your role.


A change says it’s waiting for approval Send the link your client gives you to a Wolfia Admin.


You’re asked to sign in again Sign in once more. This happens after 90 days without use, or if your client lost its saved sign-in.


You see a rate limit error Wait for the time the error gives, then try again.


## Frequently asked questions


### How do I connect Wolfia to Claude?


In Claude, go to Customize > Connectors, click Add, then Add custom connector, and enter[https://api.wolfia.com/mcp](https://api.wolfia.com/mcp) as the MCP server URL. Click Add, then Connect, and sign in with your Wolfia account. On a Team or Enterprise plan, an Owner adds Wolfia once under Organization settings > Connectors and each member then connects with their own Wolfia account.


### How do I connect Wolfia to ChatGPT?


Go to ChatGPT Plugins, select Add, then Add custom MCP server, and enter[https://api.wolfia.com/mcp](https://api.wolfia.com/mcp) as the server URL with OAuth authentication. Create it as a plugin, install it, then type @ in a new conversation and select Wolfia.


### What is the Wolfia MCP server URL?


The Wolfia MCP server URL is[https://api.wolfia.com/mcp](https://api.wolfia.com/mcp) , with no trailing slash.


### What can Claude or ChatGPT see in Wolfia?


Only what you can see. Every tool runs as you, with your Wolfia role, inside your organization. A connection that asks for read access alone gets only the tools that read.


### Can Claude or ChatGPT change data in Wolfia?


Yes, within your role. Changes that are hard to undo, such as deleting something, approving a whole email domain or publishing a trust center update, wait for a Wolfia Admin to approve them in Wolfia, and your AI client can’t approve anything.


### Which Claude plans can use the Wolfia connector?


On Free, Pro, Max and Ultra plans you add Wolfia yourself as a custom connector. On Team and Enterprise plans an Owner adds it once for the organization, and each member connects with their own Wolfia account.
